get.summary: Retrieve a count of all files that match the query string
get.description: Retrieve a count of all files that match the query string criteria provided in the URI using an account-mailboxId pairing. Class code may be provided to filter by class code. get.summary: Retrieve a list of all files that match the query string
get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all files that match the query string criteria provided in the URI using an account-mailboxId pairing. This is a JSON-formatted collection with each object containing detailed information on a single file. Class code may be provided to filter by class code. This endpoint accepts headers used to identify the recipient's Agency Management System, Operating System, and optional information unique to this recipient. Files are retrieved on a page by page basis determined by page and pageSize.
